scope.input: Same saved blueprints from the historical report; source and blueprint hashes verified.
scope.baselineMeasurement: Reused after values from /workspace/scratch/placement-physics-comparison-final.json; source-matched intrinsic engine/configuration values are read afresh without computeStats.
scope.migration: Nozzle support is actual additional structural material. Mass, HP and construction price can increase; total heat capacity and mass-dependent acceleration/other limits are recalculated. Operational availability can also change when an actual support repairs a formerly detached engine.
scope.runtime: Cold healthy initial state, balanced allocation, full maneuver, .25 s power step. Not a steady-state heat or full combat balance measurement.
scope.timings: Historical durations are provenance, not speed comparison. No browser/FPS/Safari/process-memory claim.
scope.units: mass tonnes; volume cubic metres; power watts; heat joules; acceleration metres per second squared.

checks.name: total mass delta equals reported support material mass delta
support mass delta follows the existing 0.3 tonnes per cubic metre material rule
framing mass is retained
reactor rated power is retained
support HP follows existing material and hpPerT rules
heat capacity follows total mass with unchanged coefficient
nozzle/machinery positions, dimensions and settings are retained
individual intrinsic ratings and mechanical/electrical configuration are retained
current compute does not rewrite engine authoring parameters

cases.interpretation: Every observed physical/profile/runtime difference is listed, not ignored. Intrinsic settings are invariant; aggregate usable thrust/input can differ from geometry-based availability and the retained limits. No claim that the support is weightless or that all physical values remain exact.

executionConditions.purpose: Final functional physical/model invariants on identical saved blueprints; not a performance benchmark.
executionConditions.currentSources: Final live repository runtime, not the earlier immutable low-poly capture.
executionConditions.cpuShared: Root selected/related/energy Node regression suites ran concurrently during part of this comparison. Wall times must not be used for speed comparisons.
executionConditions.sourceIdentity: Git HEAD names the checkout parent. The before/after source hashes identify the actual tested bytes, including final uncommitted changes.

preTrenchLowpolySnapshotComparison.scope: Only these same four saved inputs. Metadata profileVersion changed21to22; elapsedMs is a timing field and is not a physical/configuration value. Both metadata fields are explicitly separated from the comparison.
